description:
Retrieve appConsentRequest objects and their properties.

TIP: Lists app consent requests. When users request access to apps that require admin consent, those requests appear here. Each has appId, appDisplayName, and pendingScopes. Use to review and manage pending consent requests.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-app-consent-requests
